# Product backlog - acceptance criteria for every story

One file per work item, holding its **verbatim acceptance criteria** as they
stand in Jira. This exists so that code review - human or AI - can check a
change against the criteria it is supposed to satisfy, without anyone leaving
the repo.

## How to use it

Every branch, commit and PR in this repo carries a SCRUM key (see `CLAUDE.md`).
That key is the filename:

```
branch SCRUM-19-approve-reject  ->  docs/backlog/SCRUM-19.md
```

Subtasks have files too, so a branch cut from a subtask key resolves the same
way and links back to its parent story.

Before you open a PR, read your story's file and check every criterion is
either covered by a test or visibly not done yet. Reviewers do the same.

## Staleness - read this

**Jira is the source of truth. These files are a snapshot, last synced on 2026-10-21.**

- Never edit these files by hand. Edit the story in Jira, then re-sync.
- Re-sync after every backlog refinement, and before each sprint review.
- If a file disagrees with Jira, Jira wins - and the sync is overdue.
